action.action-desc: Ms. Cortez Masto (for herself, Mr. Cassidy, Ms. Warren, and Mrs. Blackburn) introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance

form.official-title: To amend title XVIII of the Social Security Act to require the inclusion of certain information in encounter data under Medicare Advantage.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Encounter Data Enhancement Act.

section.header: Inclusion of certain information in encounter data under Medicare Advantage
section.text: Section 1859 of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395w–28) is amended by adding at the end the following new subsection:

subsection.header: Inclusion of certain information in encounter data

paragraph.text: In the case of any encounter data submitted by a Medicare Advantage plan with respect to an item or service furnished to an individual under such plan during a plan year beginning on or after January 1, 2026, the Secretary shall require that such data include—

subparagraph.text: the type of payment from the plan to the provider, such as, but not limited to capitation, value-based, or fee-for-service;
the allowed amount for such item or service;
the amount of cost sharing (including deductibles, copayments, and coinsurance) imposed for such item or service;
an indicator identifying encounter records including the provision of an at-home health risk assessment by a specified assessment entity;
an indicator identifying encounter records including the provision of an at-home health risk assessment by an assessment entity not described in subparagraph (D);
an indicator identifying encounter records including the provision of an at-home health risk assessment by an entity not described in subparagraph (D) or (E);
an indicator identifying encounter records including the provision of a health risk assessment outside of the home by any entity;
an indicator of whether the item or service was provided in-network for the plan; and
the standard unique health identifier (described in section 1173(b)) of the ordering provider, in the case of data submitted with respect to—

clause.text: durable medical equipment, prosthetics, orthotics, and supplies;
other items or services as determined by the Secretary.

subparagraph.text: The term assessment entity means an entity with a focus on furnishing in-home health risk assessments, as specified by the Secretary.

The term specified assessment entity means, with respect to an MA organization and a plan year, an assessment entity with respect to which such organization (or any person with an ownership or control interest (as defined in section 1124(a)(3)) in such organization) is a person with an ownership or control interest (as so defined).
